sourceRefs.locator: Text of Brooke’s signed receipt, paragraphs 1–3. Specifies the Hôtel de la Compagnie, keys and inventories, instructions to employees, letters and telegrams, and the three languages of the instrument. The contemporary Star & Herald extract below dates the report to 5 May.

Preliminary Inventory 91, introduction pp. 1–2 and records of the two French companies, pp. 5–6, entries 1–6. Describes the transfer of the French archives and destruction of parts of them, the sale (including railroad shares), maps, profiles and records passing between the companies.
Account of the building in the Casco Antiguo: the former Grand Hôtel became the offices of the Compagnie Universelle. The page locates the museum on Plaza de la Independencia.
